verdict.rationale: Outlook's own Inbox rules are documented as automatically handling incoming messages, for example by forwarding them, and automatic replies can be configured. These run without the user present, but they are event-triggered mail rules rather than general or AI-driven agentic automations. Change notifications are developer building blocks and do not earn credit here. Missing for 10: recurring or scheduled automations (only incoming-message triggers are evidenced), AI or agentic autonomous workflows, automation scope beyond inbox rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
Get or update a user's automatic reply, locale, time zone, or working hours
